name: caller-principal-require-class-admits-the-bound-principal
description: R14 for a require-class route both runtimes implement, in the PRINCIPAL-PRESENT state: session A claims (Python only -- the preflight is scoped, since Node answers 404) and its stop presents the principal. Python checks it and admits; Node gets no header (omitted where the claim was not issued, as a conforming client does after a 404). Both answer the same. The absent-and-bound state is fixture 03; absent-and-unbound is warn_mode/05.
